token_help: Leave blank to keep the saved token.
coef_help: Enter the datasheet number: −0.35%/°C → −0.35. No conversion needed.
select_source: Search or enter a sensor entity
hold_help: After this time without a source report, data is missing. Held states are estimates, not new measurements.
night: PR is undefined when estimated power is zero.
zero_expected_power: Estimated power is zero; PR is unavailable.
current_source_unavailable: A current source is unavailable or stale.
ha_connection_failed: Cannot reach Home Assistant. Check the URL, token and connection.
connection_required: Configure a Home Assistant connection first.
origin_mismatch: This request came from a different site.
history_unavailable: HA history is unavailable; collecting live data.
source_semantics: Use instantaneous or persistent state sensors. Interval averages require a separate adapter.
energy_help: Energy includes only periods with all three sources valid. Missing time is never filled with zero.
app_connection: Connected through Home Assistant Supervisor. No token setup needed.
recovery_note: Recovered history appears here; HA records restored totals at the time they are republished.
plot_empty: The chart will appear when valid data arrives.
stat_value_hint: Averages use the valid portion of each window.
